1	# KINTSUGI-Ω: An Immune System for AI Agents
2	
3	> Repairs that show their seams in gold.
4	
5	**Master Edition.** This repository continues KINTSUGI-Ω beyond the hackathon (Stages 9–13). The
6	#neatHack submission is frozen at
7	[suryaprasanthcse/kintsugi-omega@13a744b](https://github.com/suryaprasanthcse/kintsugi-omega/tree/13a744b)
8	and is never modified; everything below describes that submitted state until this edition's own
9	stages land. The plan is in [MASTER_HANDOFF.md](MASTER_HANDOFF.md).
10	
11	KINTSUGI-Ω is our #neatHack 2026 entry: an autonomous reliability system for a fleet of AI
12	agents, modelled on the adaptive immune system. It senses failures with
13	[neatlogs](https://neatlogs.com), remembers and proves every change with
14	[Entire](https://entire.io), and prices every repair with [cfo.ai](https://cfo.ai).
15	
16	## The problem
17	
18	AI agents fail in production quietly. A refactor ships, the tests stay green, and a retry starts
19	posting duplicate ledger lines. Today's coding agents:
20	
21	- **ship unverified fixes**: a patch that passes unit tests can still regress on the traffic
22	  that broke it;
23	- **pay full price for every repeat**: the same bug on the next repository costs a whole new LLM
24	  investigation, so repair cost grows linearly with the fleet;
25	- **ask to be trusted**: their logs and "fixed it" claims are self-reported.
26	
27	## How it works
28	
29	```
30	 neatlogs traces ──► SENSES ──► CREW ─────────────────────► GATES G0–G7 ──► SHIP (PR, CI)
31	 (grader.verdict)    receptors   Sentinel → Pathologist      reproduce · unit · replay ·      │
32	                     webhook +   (Entire code graph,         paired holdout statistics ·      ▼
33	                     poller      blast radius) → Surgeons    intent · budget · independent   CANARY (SPRT)
34	                                 (competing, sandboxed) →    CI                               │ reject → auto-revert
35	                                 blind Auditor                                                ▼
36	 MEMORY: Immunologist turns a solved incident into an antibody (motif on the code graph +
37	 receptor + recipe) → matures it on another host → vaccinates the fleet; harm → quarantine,
38	 contrastive refinement.
39	 PROOF: every commit signed (Ed25519) and linked to its Entire checkpoint; hash-chained ledger
40	 with signed hourly anchors; sealed sabotage; `kintsugi audit` C1–C14 re-checks all of it.
41	```
42	
43	- **Senses**: neatlogs receptors watch the `grader.verdict` span of every agent run; a webhook and
44	  a reconciling poller open incidents and dedupe hits.
45	- **Crew**: headless Claude Code roles. A blind Auditor runs deterministic gates G0–G7. Its G4
46	  pairs the candidate against the baseline on an age-encrypted holdout that the crew never sees.
47	- **Provenance**: each crew commit carries signed `Kintsugi-*` trailers and an `Entire-Checkpoint`
48	  trailer; an orchestrator-decided change (revert, regression cases) runs inside a templated
49	  **notary** session, so every commit has a session behind it.
50	- **Economics**: every incident and vaccination is costed; the governor keeps spend under budget.
51	
52	## Results (rehearsals on disposable hosts)
53	
54	From the Stage 6 and Stage 7 rehearsals (`evidence/rehearsals/l3-20261012-074523.json`,
55	[`antibodies/AB-1`](antibodies/AB-1), [docs/VERIFICATION.md](docs/VERIFICATION.md)):
56	
57	| What | Result |
58	|---|---|
59	| Primary response (Stage 6) | `INC-R235459-0001`, duplicate ledger postings on the Ledger practice host, resolved by the crew through gates G0–G7 ([PR #5](https://github.com/suryaprasanthcse/kintsugi-omega/pull/5), G7 green in Actions, canary accepted): **$0.665** |
60	| Antibody AB-1@1.0 | synthesised from that incident; the motif matches the code before the fix and not after |
61	| Maturation on a second host | CRM practice host, gates **G0–G6 pass** (G4: b=6, c=0, p=0.0156): [PR #7](https://github.com/suryaprasanthcse/kintsugi-omega/pull/7) (PR-only, a foreign host) |
62	| Receptor | precision **1.00 over 335** recorded runs → ACTIVE |
63	| Backfill | **6 silent past failures**, **$12.00** of impact |
64	| Vaccinations | **$0.089** (CRM) and **$0.104** (Scout) vs $0.665 primary: **~7× cheaper per repeated bug** |
65	| L3 autoimmunity (**disclosed drill**) | the literal recipe was forced onto Scout past a failed Auditor verdict ([PR #8](https://github.com/suryaprasanthcse/kintsugi-omega/pull/8)); the canary SPRT rejected it at n=38; Omega reverted through an attested notary session ([PR #9](https://github.com/suryaprasanthcse/kintsugi-omega/pull/9), reverse canary accepted at n=70), quarantined AB-1, added 6 seed-addressed regression cases ([PR #10](https://github.com/suryaprasanthcse/kintsugi-omega/pull/10)) |
66	| Contrastive learning | AB-1@1.1 learned the precondition "a side-effecting callee inside the retried scope" (true on the 3 protected hosts, false on Scout) and re-matured to ACTIVE |
67	
68	## The proof plane: don't trust it, audit it
69	
70	`kintsugi audit` (spec §7.5) re-checks the autonomy window from public data:
71	
72	| Check | Verifies |
73	|---|---|
74	| C1 | ledger hash chain from h_0, signed hourly `anchor-*` tags, bundle digests |
75	| C2–C5 | every protected-branch commit attested, signature valid, Entire checkpoint holds the nonce, first prompt hashes to `Kintsugi-Prompt` |
76	| C6 | sealed sabotage opens only to its commitment, sealed before delivery, honeytoken never leaked |
77	| C7–C10, C12 | G7 CI runs, trace existence, completeness of detection hits, cost within 1%, rulesets active |
78	| C11, C13, C14 | antibody lineage replays, holdout manifest unchanged, self-repairs never touch the proof plane |
79	
80	A check whose inputs are missing reports **SKIP, never PASS** (exit 0 pass · 1 fail · 2 skipped).
81	A 33-test mutation suite proves each check catches its own tampering: a rewritten ledger caught
82	by its anchor, a forged signature, a missing nonce, a planted honeytoken and more.
83	
84	```bash
85	uv sync --locked
86	uv run kintsugi audit --all --offline ./published-bundles   # today: C11, C14 PASS; the rest SKIP (no window ran); exit 2
87	uv run pytest tests/proof/test_audit.py -q                  # 33 tamper tests
88	uv run kintsugi t0 check                                    # what a real autonomy window still needs
89	make check                                                  # ruff, pyright, full test suite
90	```
